papers.title: Treatment Outcomes and Clinical Characteristics of Patients with KRAS-G12C Mutant Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

article_alerts.restriction: Retrospective KRAS G12C versus non-G12C comparisons do not prove equivalent treatment effects. Distinguish PFS from time to treatment discontinuation, retain nonsignificant PD-L1-high trends, and do not infer STK11- or KEAP1-specific treatment prediction from similar co-mutation frequencies.

papers.title: STK11/LKB1 Mutations in NSCLC Are Associated with KEAP1/NRF2-Dependent Radiotherapy Resistance Targetable by Glutaminase Inhibition

article_alerts.restriction: Clinical stageIII n164 includes only12 STK11-mutant cases, with endpoint-specific n162 for LRR/DM. KEAP1 was not clinically assayed. The cohort predates routine durvalumab. Table5 adjusts OS for age only alongside STK11; DM and several experimental contrasts are nonsignificant. DCFDA/MitoSOX protocols, restored-LKB1 DER .8/.9 and xenograft denominators conflict. CB-839+RT evidence is in vitro, not patient benefit or proven drug synergy. Online2020, issue2021.

papers.title: Cross-Site Concordance Evaluation of Tumor DNA and RNA Sequencing Platforms for the CIMAC-CIDC Network

article_alerts.restriction: Eight patients, not150 independent patients. medTIN30 does not meet the prespecified.94 correlation threshold; concordance is not accuracy or efficacy. Reopen ccr-2021-33323402-evidence.md before factual reuse.

papers.title: Efficacy and Biomarker Analysis of Camrelizumab in Combination with Apatinib in Patients with Advanced Nonsquamous NSCLC Previously Treated with Chemotherapy

article_alerts.restriction: STK11/KEAP1-mutant means either-gene union, not confirmed double mutation. Read the article-specific source alerts before numerical reuse.

papers.title: A Performance Comparison of Commonly Used Assays to Detect RET Fusions

article_alerts.restriction: DNA rearrangement is not necessarily an expressed oncogenic RET fusion:105/151 composite-positive cases were not RNA-confirmed. DNA46/46 sensitivity uses the selectively co-tested4525 set; FISH/IHC use different enriched denominators and reference definitions. IHC validation is internal, not external. Partner-dependent misses, especially NCOA4, limit transfer. Plasma5/16 includes3RNA-negative SVUS, not a fusion sensitivity estimate;4selected treated responders are not validated100% population ORR. N/C-terminal fusion architecture is inconsistent in the Introduction and held from language reuse. IHC/FISH are not proteomics or transcriptome-wide assays.

papers.title: Transcriptional Subtypes Resolve Tumor Heterogeneity and Identify Vulnerabilities to MEK Inhibition in Lung Adenocarcinoma

article_alerts.restriction: MUC/PRO/MES states integrate different cohorts and models. Functional STK11/KEAP1 deficiency in the PRO state is not identical to mutation status. papers.title: Genome and Transcriptome Biomarkers of Response to Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors in Advanced Solid Tumors

article_alerts.restriction: 98 mixed-tumor patients;82 treatment-naive biopsies; immune models65 after lymphoid exclusions. DCB is not response rate and TTP is not PFS. Bulk deconvolution is not single-cell. Different endpoints and negative external validation must be preserved; JAK1/HLA case has temporal/site confounding.

papers.title: Identification of Deleterious NOTCH Mutation as Novel Predictor to Efficacious Immunotherapy in NSCLC

article_alerts.restriction: Del-NOTCH treatment interaction differs by endpoint: PFS P=.012 but OS P=.255. Do not claim confirmed OS predictive interaction. Docetaxel del-NOTCH ORR conflicts between p9 prose (9.3%) and Figure5A p10 (5.6%); do not reuse either without disclosing the conflict. Preserve WT PFS P=.279/.297, local94%/95%CI and localOS Fig1/Fig2 estimate conflicts. Several DDR/immune enrichment tests are nonsignificant. Overlapping cohorts are not unique ICI patients, and predicted damage is not proven loss of function. STK11 adjusted associations are not STK11-by-treatment interaction or mechanism.

papers.title: Baseline Plasma Tumor Mutation Burden Predicts Response to Pembrolizumab-based Therapy in Patients with Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

article_alerts.restriction: Four-gene negative-predictor union is not a four-gene co-mutant genotype or independently validated gene-specific treatment predictor. Endpoint-optimized pTMB cutoff is cohort/assay specific; OS P=.061 and mutation-only comparisons remain nonsignificant. Read the article-specific source alerts before numerical reuse.

papers.title: Organoid Cultures as Preclinical Models of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

article_alerts.restriction: Normal airway overgrowth and malignant identity must be resolved before treating a culture as a tumor model. Initial57/65 culture establishment is not10/65 long-term success; contamination7/12 is not7/65. Nine models contribute23 sequenced samples. Figure5D BGJ398+BKM120 combination index is above1 atED50 but below1 atED75, not uniformly synergistic. Figure4 single-star annotation means P>.05, and p11 short-term MEK wording conflicts with p8/Figure4 long-term experiments. These preclinical findings do not establish prospective patient predictive utility or direct STK11 evidence.
